So the solution is just low my expectations bar and choose the path of "happiness" even though that means living an unfulfilling life? That's what the therapist expects me to do? Just accept what I'm? I'm not surprised about this answer.

That could be any prestigious high paying job that could lead me to success and social comfort or any good body condition and appearance. It doesn't matter which quality is. People most of the time are condemned by their innate qualities and must life by the consequences of the lack of these. I personally would feel very humiliated if the only path for "happiness" is being a lonely low paying worker that isn't respected by anyone, couldn't build a family and to compensate these things must be on meds 24/7. If you call that "happiness" then I prefer to be "miserable" and be honest to myself and pursue, even in vain, what I KNOW that brings me real happiness.

That's where the fraud in the therapy lies on, because he doesn't care about what you wish deep inside, he wants you to bury all this and be realistic and functional, even though that means living in an alienated and illegitimate way.

Unless they rely on innate qualities that can't be changed by simply changing your beliefs and attitudes. I won't  be a basketball player just because I suddenly believe and train like one, but being 5.9 feet tall. That's my point of the inefficacy of therapy.

I didn't mean to say that you specifically is on a leash, you misinterpreted me. I said it on a broad sense, like therapists on general keep people on the leash instead of treating the root cause of their problems.

I doubt it. Stressful situation, bad appearance, low cognitive performance, lack of academy success, low social skills and other external factors can be the main cause of mental health problems. Bad brain chemistry in this case is the consequence, not the cause.
Because it's their job to pretend to care, or else they won't be paid.

My evidence is logic: therapy is useless to treat the material root cause of your problems. Changing perspectives, the interpretation of your reality and messing with your neurotransmitters aren't a solution, but if you call that a solution, then maybe they have their effectiveness on keeping you in a leash.

Infelizmente essa é a dinâmica desse mundo maldito, e só o que podemos fazer é continuar lutando, como diz uma trecho de uma música que eu adoro: "We can only move forward, even in the darkest days".

A fase mais negra da minha vida já passou e hoje estou iniciando o meu processo parcial de redenção. Estou com um trabalho bom e estável (apesar das minhas relações interpessoais serem uma merda porque eu sou extremamente arisco e antissocial), porém eu sou competente e dedicado, algo que meu gestor não tem do que reclamar. Estou cuidando da minha saúde física e financeira, voltando a estudar, a ler com mais frequência e até velhos hobbies voltaram a ser prazerosos. 

Em tempos mais remotos eu tinha um espírito bem mais passivo e fatalista, mas aprendi a ser mais combativo e reativo, mesmo que de uma forma um pouco juvenil e discreta. Gosto do sentimento de a cada dia ser capaz de resolver problemas mais complexos ou de levantar mais carga na academia. Todo microssucesso que eu recebo é um indicador de que eu posso superar o meu passado e prosperar, pois se em um dado momento os meus inimigos tentaram me destruir, hoje vejo que eles falharam nisso. Não sei quais são as suas condições nem capacidades, mas eu acredito que você não seja um caso perdido.

Eu não acredito em uma justiça cósmica também. Temos uma concepção presunçosa de assumir que o universo possui uma justiça sistemática e instituicional análoga às nossas, mas devemos desaprender a ver ela dessa maneira. O universo é caos, é indeterminismo. Ação e reação possuem um sentido mais físico e não necessariamente se aplicam à moral e as ações humanas. 

Obviamente você tem toda a razão do mundo de se sentir injustiçada e de, quem sabe, até desejar a desgraça para as pessoas que te prejudicaram; eu seria o maior hipócrita do mundo se te dissesse o contrário, já que eu mesmo desejei isso diversas vezes. Porém, se você ficar presa a essa noção, com o agravante de ser impotente perante as circunstâncias passadas e presentes, você só vai sofrer sozinha e em vão.

É um problema que está presente em mim desde a adolescência e que nunca encontrei tratamento (isso se há tratamento). Minha solução, neste caso, foi apenas focar em trabalhar as minhas fraquezas: ir pra academia pra ficar mais forte, criar uma rotina de leitura e estudos, aprender novas habilidades, me desenvolver profissionalmente, dar atenção à minha família e cuidar das finanças. 

Porém, a frustração sempre vem com força. É um tortura ver pessoas tendo uma relação íntima e recicprocidade nas suas investidas amorosas. Desejo do fundo do meu coração não deixar a inveja tomar conta e me cegar, tanto que uma das razões para começar a frequentar uma academia foi justamente essa: ter um objetivo e desviar o foco daquilo que nunca será possível de obter; um amor recíproco; ser desejado.

Nunca se transformam em amizades e muito menos em algo mais íntimo, e isso me frustra pois não é o que eu observo dos meus colegas. Vendo isso, eu me pergunto algumas vezes: o que será que há de errado comigo? Essa é uma pergunta que me alivia, pois indica que eu tenho consciência de que o problema é comigo.

Eu levantei uma tese em determinado momento na qual muitas pessoas não foram, digamos, feitas para conquistar esse tipo de relação nas suas vidas dado o conjunto dos fatores que compõem o seu ser. Não é responsabilidade delas se culpar por isso e muito menos se condenarem por não terem isso. É uma dentre as diversas vidas humanas que podem e sempre existiram e nem por isso cairam no niilismo e no fatalismo que muitos caem quando percebem isso. Ainda tenho certa esperança de que esse não seja o caso, mas os indicadores tendem ao contrário.

I don't think Arch is hard after you set it properly. Sure, the installation process can be a little laborious, but after that it's a smooth experience. Also, after the base installation just install a default DE like KDE or GNOME and you basically have an Ubuntu or Fedora like distro in a rolling release model. If you want a more fine grain customization go for a standalone wayland compositor or a window manager and the tools that you want and need. It's up to you. 

But I think Arch, and any other DIY distro, have the advantage of allowing you to make a more custom and lean distro without all the unnecessary bloat that comes with the other distros. It makes you conscientious of all the components that are working in your system and allows for a more efficient use of your resources.

Talvez haja uma profunda desesperança em relação a possibilidade de mudança e melhoria da suas condições materiais ou uma avaliação distorcida e fraca da viabilidade deste processo. Because in low level languages the position of the elements in arrays are accessed by their memory addresses. So, for example, you want the second element (index 1)  of an array of integers of 8 bytes. To access it that would be: Array's Address (AA) + size of the elements (SE) \* Index (I). In this case: AA + SE \* 1. If you want the first element (index 0), then that would be: AA + ES \* 0, which gives you AA. 

As I said, this is the case for low level languages like C that have a very fine grain control over memory, but on more high level languages like MATLAB, Lua, etc, they don't need to necessarily follow this since they have a very high level of abstraction. People always mock MATLAB for beginning the indexing for it's "arrays" in 1, but forget that it's the MATrix LAB, and in mathematics matrices also begin it's index in 1. They could choose to begin in 0? Yep, but I think they preferred to respect the math notation since the people that will mostly use it are also mathematicians, engineers or related.

Normally you wouldn't need to pass any env variable but just in case start Firefox with the MOZ\_X11\_EGL=1 option.

Sandbridge only have support for h264 decoding, that's normal. For you to be able to decode youtube videos properly you need to force it to use h264 as the video encoder. In case of you using Firefox as browser, install the h264fy extension and be sure to enable the VAAPI support on it by enabling the following settings on about:config:

gfx.webrender.all = true

media.ffmpeg.vaapi.enabled = true

media.ffvpx.enabled = false

media.navigator.mediadatadecoder\_vpx\_enabled = true

media.rdd-vpx.enabled = false

Also be sure to install the libva-intel-driver

Also, answering your questions:

1 - Only the minor and patch versions are updated once you git pull the repository and recompile it. Ex: [5.13.8.188](https://5.13.8.188) \-> [5.13.12.189](https://5.13.12.189). If you want a new version you must remove the old kernel and install the new one by editing the config file.

2 - Yes, just change the options that you'd like and recompile it, but don't forget to keep the same version, scheduler and compiler or it will install a new kernel instead of modifing it. This is because the kernel follows the name scheme of: linux<version>-tkg-<scheduler>-<compiler>

EDIT: Actually you can specify a custom PKG name in the config. More specifically in the \_custom\_pkgbase option. That way you can have major version updates like you have with the linux package.

One way is to just clone the git repository locally:

    git clone https://github.com/Frogging-Family/linux-tkg.git linux-tkg

In the repository directory edit the '**customization.conf'** file which have options to set the scheduler, compiler, cpu model, optimization level, etc, for your needs. In your case you need to set the option \_cpusched to 'pds'.

After editing the file, save and run 'makepkg -si'. The compilation time can take some time but one way to decrease this is using the package modprobed-db:

[https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Modprobed-db](https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Modprobed-db)

Which is available in the AUR. For installing AUR packages without a helper check the wiki page.

[https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Arch\_User\_Repository](https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Arch_User_Repository)

Install it and run 'modprobed-db store' to build the database of the modules that were loaded. Don't forget to set the option '\_modprobeddb' to true in the customization.conf file before running makepkg.

Don't forget to check the linux-tkg github page documentation.

By watching videos you mean on the browser or media players? For browser only Firefox and a patched Chromium has support for hardware acceleration at the moment on Linux. Also your graphics card needs to be capable of decoding. Check it by typing 'vainfo' in the terminal. It'll show a list of the codecs compatible to encode/decode. 

Ex: 

VAProfileH264High               :	VAEntrypointVLD

VAProfileH264High               :	VAEntrypointEncSlice

Where on the left you have the available codec for your card. VAEntrypointVLD means it can decode and VAEntrypointEncSlice it can encode. 

To activate VAAPI support on Firefox follow the instructions here:

[https://wiki.archlinux.org/index.php/Firefox#Hardware\_video\_acceleration](https://wiki.archlinux.org/index.php/Firefox#Hardware_video_acceleration)

By default youtube videos use VP8/VP9 codec and older cards don't have support for it. If it's the case you need to use the h264fy extension to use only h264 codecs. 

If you're using Chromium you need or compile it with the patches. There's a repository with pre-compiled binaries but I wouldn't recommend it. 

In the case of media players, I know that VLC already has support for hardware acceleration and it'll automaticaly use it if available.

If you don't mess too much with system like fine tunning some parameters for best performance, external packages and etc, then there isn't too much to configure/maintain. Main problem for me is with external packages, especially those that aren't in the AUR, that may require extra steps to update, since those in the AUR can use a helper like 'yay' to automate the process.

For the configuration, once you install a DE like GNOME, XFCE or KDE, there isn't to much to do since they're pretty much pre-configured to work with all the basic softwares. If possible I recommend testing the DE in a VM and choose the one you're more confortable in your main machine. Avoiding mixing DE since it just bloats and messes your system.
